label: Christoph Benzmüller and Bruno…, Gödel's…: Modal collapse: at every world, whatever proposition is…
interpretation: Lemma MC in the theory's section 'Modal Collapse': the theory says Gödel's axioms 'have been criticized for entailing the so-called modal collapse' and that the prover Satallax confirms it, but it leaves the lemma unproved in Isabelle (oops). The claim attributes only that the theory states MC as a consequence its axioms are reported to entail, not an Isabelle proof of it. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Scott's notes, not to what Scott or Gödel intended.
